messages:
lina_pm: Spin up quick thread: proposal for 'autopin' safety net. Auto-unpin models that fail benchmark stability for 30d unless tenant opts in. Goal: reduce pin backlog and maintenance for legacy models.
omar_eng: what's the failure signal? absolute perf drop or regression vs pinned baseline? Also need API to re-pin.
lina_pm: plan: two signals: (1) sustained delta >8% vs pinned baseline over 30d OR (2) sudden regression >12% in 7d. If triggered, we 1) mark as autopending-unpin, 2) hold 14d for tenant opt-out, 3) unpin.
julie_csm: for paying customers require CS review before unpin. For self-serve allow auto flow. Provide migration credit and clear comms + in-console banner.
tess_sre: ops: ensure fallback routing exists. If unpin causes errors, immediate revert route available. Add trace tag autopin.unpin and alerts on error-rate and latency.
omar_eng: dev tasks: evaluator job, tenant preference UI, unpin API, re-pin API, audit log. Pseudocode config: {"window_days":30,"delta_thresh":0.08,"grace_days":14,"enterprise_hold":true}.
julie_csm: comms timeline: notice->7d reminder->48h final. We'll prepare templates and escalation.
lina_pm: prioritization: Q3 candidate; small scope MVP first for long-tail self-serve tenants. I'll draft PRD and include sample thresholds.
omar_eng: ok will prototype evaluator next sprint.
